
{{alias}}( c, d )
    Returns the median of a Burr (type III) distribution with first shape
    parameter `c` and second shape parameter `d`.

    If provided `NaN` as any argument, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `c <= 0` or `d <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    c: number
        First shape parameter.

    d: number
        Second shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Median.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 2.0, 1.0 )
    1.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 4.0, 12.0 )
    ~2.025
    > y = {{alias}}( 8.0, 2.0 )
    ~1.116
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN, 2.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 2.0, NaN )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( -1.0, 2.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 2.0, -1.0 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
